name: Mysterious Girl
source:
[i]"I came here to look for God."[/i]

A mysterious girl that shows up on the island one day.
She wears an unfamiliar school uniform and dons a sword at her hip.
Her hair is silver and she acts prim and proper—almost like a high school aged Ginka.

[Taken from [url=http://ginka.frontwing.jp/en/characters/?nazo]Official English page[/url]]
